§Mamba-1 Inference Caches

The state that the block carries between calls. In training or prefill, Mamba1::forward processes the whole sequence at once. In decoding, Mamba1::step processes one token per call. Both modes carry the same two pieces of state:

  1. Convolution window — the last conv_kernel pre-activation inputs to the depthwise Conv1d. With it, each step applies the causal filter without processing earlier tokens again.

  2. State — the per-channel state matrix. It compresses the full past into a fixed size, for any number of tokens.

Mamba1::zero_cache builds the cache of a fresh sequence. Mirrors crate::mamba2::cache. The Mamba-1 state has no head axis.
